issues.message: No explicit NFRs defined for performance (response times, throughput), security (authentication, authorization, data encryption), scalability (concurrent users, data volume), or availability (uptime targets, disaster recovery)
Rating column lacks CHECK constraint to enforce valid range (1-5). Should add: CHECK (rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5)
No explicit session management table or token storage mechanism defined. Authentication strategy (JWT, sessions) should be documented with corresponding schema if needed
Consider adding composite index on orders(user_id, created_at) for user order history queries, and index on flowers(price) for price-based filtering
No data retention, archival, or deletion policy specified for old orders, notifications, or cart data
Limited documentation of error states and error handling UI patterns across screens (network errors, payment failures, out of stock scenarios)

required_fixes: Define Non-Functional Requirements including performance targets (page load < 2s, API response < 500ms), security requirements (HTTPS, password hashing algorithm, PCI compliance for payments), and scalability goals (support X concurrent users)
Add CHECK constraint to reviews.rating column: ALTER TABLE reviews ADD CONSTRAINT rating_range CHECK (rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5)
Document authentication and session management strategy with any required database tables or fields (e.g., refresh_tokens table if using JWT)
recommendations: Add composite indexes for common query patterns: CREATE INDEX idx_orders_user_created ON orders(user_id, created_at DESC) for efficient user order history retrieval
Define data retention policy: specify retention periods for completed orders (e.g., 7 years for tax compliance), old notifications (e.g., 90 days), and abandoned carts (e.g., 30 days)
Enhance error handling documentation in design: create a comprehensive error state catalog showing UI patterns for network failures, validation errors, payment failures, and out-of-stock scenarios
Consider adding audit logging table to track sensitive operations (order status changes, price modifications, user role changes) for compliance and debugging
Add rate limiting specifications to NFRs to prevent abuse of APIs (e.g., max 100 requests per minute per user)
Document backup and disaster recovery strategy including RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and RPO (Recovery Point Objective) targets
Consider adding a product_images table for multiple images per flower instead of single image_url, supporting the gallery feature shown in design
Add monitoring and alerting requirements to NFRs (e.g., alert when order processing time exceeds threshold, low stock notifications)
